notes:
## Changes
- **CRTN contour maps are about five times faster.** P2000's contour map takes about 2 minutes instead of about 11. The heaviest CRTN geometry (ground heights along each path, terrain crests, building screening) now runs as compiled code that does exactly the same arithmetic, so every level is unchanged to the last digit. The first calculation after updating takes a few seconds longer while it compiles.

## Bug fixes
- **A sports court's LAFmax set to "Nearest plausible point" could come out far too low.** The ball strike was placed on the court edge, which can be the foot of the court's own glass end wall, so the wall screened it and LAFmax came out only a few dB above LAeq. The event is now placed at the nearest point in play (1 m inside the edge), and is never quieter than the event at the court centre.
